note: Area 1 parts shops and the garage's repairs (GDD 8.3 to 8.5, Spec 7.4, 14.4 to 14.6). Prices are in pounds for a new Grade 1 part on a 50cc; each grade costs gradeFactor times the one below. slotBase values not given in Spec 14.4 (bottom end, shock, brakes, bodywork, wheels and tyres as one slot) are first-pass guesses to tune in testing. Frames are not sold: they come from your sponsor or the class dealer (Spec 18.9). fitFee is the garage's bench fee for fitting a spare (provisional); parts bought in a shop are fitted there free.

shops.name: General bike shop
shops.greeting: Engine, suspension and bodywork for the 50s and 65s, Grades 1 to 3. Grade 1 is always on the shelf; the better stuff comes and goes.

shops.name: Tyres and wheels
shops.greeting: Tyres, rims, spokes and brakes. Hard pack round here, so keep an eye on that rear.

shops.name: Local garage
shops.greeting: Grade 2 and up, I'll bring it back to new, one grade down. Got spares? I'll fit them on the bench.
